articles.title: How Different Is ‘Rear Window’ From the Original Short Story?
articles.summary: The article highlights Alfred Hitchcock's 1954 film "Rear Window" as one of cinema's greatest, emphasizing the often-overlooked yet crucial contributions of screenwriter John Michael Hayes. It stresses the collaborative genius behind the movie's enduring legacy and critical acclaim, positioning it as a masterpiece whose excellence extends beyond just the director's vision.

articles.title: Trump says Putin will not attack NATO territory, downplays Ratcliffe trip
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump asserted that Russian President Vladimir Putin would not attack a NATO country. He dismissed media reports citing CIA Director John Ratcliffe's warnings about potential Russian aggression. This reflects differing perspectives within the US administration regarding the nature of the Russian threat and the security of NATO member states, a key aspect for international defence analysis.

articles.title: Tata group stock Tejas Networks zooms 13% on ₹1,537-cr order win from TCS
articles.summary: Tejas Networks' shares rallied significantly on the BSE, opening at 540.60 and peaking at 576.80, up from its 510.85 close. This surge is linked to market anticipation around a substantial 'current order'. While specific details of this order are undisclosed in the text, its mention clearly boosted investor confidence, signaling a positive outlook for the technology firm.

articles.title: Closing auction scrutiny deepens as wild Sensex swing worries traders
articles.summary: India's BSE Sensex briefly plunged approximately 3% during a 20-minute closing auction on Thursday. This significant, albeit short-lived, drop in the national stock benchmark raised serious concerns among market participants. Experts are now scrutinizing issues such as thin liquidity and potential manipulation within the trading system, highlighting vulnerabilities in market mechanisms.

articles.title: Tenbaggers on Dalal Street! 19 stocks that rallied more than 1,000% in 5 years
articles.summary: The Indian stock market recently experienced significant upswings and downswings, indicating high volatility. However, amidst these fluctuations, certain individual stocks proved resilient. They successfully avoided market downturns ('bears') and capitalized on positive trends ('bulls'), ultimately delivering stellar returns. This highlights specific opportunities even within an unpredictable market landscape.

articles.title: How Washington Can Credibly Counter China in the Pacific
articles.summary: In July, China significantly expanded its strategic reach by launching a submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) from the South China Sea into the Pacific Ocean. This demonstration highlights China's advanced naval capabilities and ability to project power across vast distances. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the increasing sophistication of global military forces and the evolving dynamics of Indo-Pacific security.
